_schema: Upcoming events shown in the site's Upcoming Events tab, as a flat list (not keyed by URL, since these are announced events rather than scraped tournaments). All fields are optional and every one degrades gracefully if left blank: a missing `date` skips the passed-event filtering (the event is always kept and sorts after every dated event, in both the tab and the pr-square's Next Tournament callout) and shows "Date TBA"; a missing `name` shows "Future Tournament"; a missing `link` renders the card as inert (non-clickable) instead of a broken link; `city`/`state`/`location` (venue) are dropped from the card line individually if blank. `description` (optional) renders as a line directly below the name. `image` (optional) is a logo URL rendered in the right 2/5 of the card -- omit it and the card stays full-width text. `color` (optional) is an "H, S%, L%" hue triple (e.g. "205, 80%, 55%") the card derives its background/border/date-color from; omit to use the default amber. Events whose `date` has already passed are dropped automatically at generation time -- no manual cleanup needed after an event happens.
